Class SwingPdfViewer

java.lang.Object
java.awt.Component
java.awt.Container
javax.swing.JComponent
javax.swing.JPanel
uno.anahata.asi.swing.agi.render.pdf.SwingPdfViewer
All Implemented Interfaces:
ImageObserver, MenuContainer, Serializable, Accessible, MediaViewerComponent
public class SwingPdfViewer extends JPanel implements MediaViewerComponent
Universal, high-performance pure-Java PDF document viewer component.

Implements MediaViewerComponent backed by Apache PDFBox. Provides asynchronous, proportional thumbnail navigation, interactive zooming, dynamic fit-to-width tracking, and integration with the standard MediaToolbar.

Author:
anahata

    • load

      public void load(byte[] data, String mimeType, String displayName, URI sourceUri)
      Loads and initializes the media data for display and playback.

      Decodes the PDF byte stream using Apache PDFBox, populates navigation models, updates toolbar metadata, and kicks off page rendering.

      Specified by:
      load in interface MediaViewerComponent
      Parameters:
      data - The raw binary data.
      mimeType - The detected MIME type (e.g. "video/mp4", "image/png", "audio/wav").
      displayName - An optional human-readable name or file name for the media item.
      sourceUri - An optional source URI on disk or remote network.

    • stop

      public void stop()
      Stops active audio or video playback, pausing decoding threads.

      PDF documents have no active media playback streams to stop.

      Specified by:
      stop in interface MediaViewerComponent
